_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, about, trading conditions, and margin pages loaded. The about page says 2024 celebrated a 15-year anniversary, but it does not state a founding year, so founded is null. The about page also says FBS operates under multiple local licences, but the legal PDFs fetched name only the Belize FSC licence 4077102. The Belize City address is the company address in the Trading Conditions, not labelled headquarters. No separate public account-type menu page was found; Cent terms are in the PDF.
